in_telugu.long_meaning: The victorious one (Jītōbho) who is the lord or god (Ish).

in_marathi.name: Gitesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gitesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gite means 'God' and Shah means 'vehicle' or 'carrier'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is often given to a child born during the auspicious time when the gods are believed to travel in their vehicles. Gitesh is a name that evokes a sense of divine protection, strength, and a connection to the divine.
